entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: A Sarpadian empire whose soldiers defended their cities to the end; the last Sarpadian empire to fall.

entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: An Icatian city whose mayor was Lydia Wynforth; it fell.

entities.name: Lydia Wynforth
entities.description: Mayor of Trokair.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: A sardonic mercenary who comments on Medics, Vodalians, Goblins, Orcs and Thrulls.

entities.name: Farrel
entities.description: A former priest, also called Oliver Farrel, who led zealots who broke from Icatia.

entities.name: Farrel's Zealots
entities.description: Vigilante followers of Farrel who fought Icatians and the followers of Tourach.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A religious order devoted to Tourach, practicing grisly rituals and breeding Thrulls.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: The figure whose principles the Order of the Ebon Hand follows; deified by followers after death.

entities.name: Orcs
entities.description: Raiders who attacked Icatian border towns and Dwarven cities.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Raiders and spies in Orcish armies, who used War Drums, Grenades and Chirurgeons.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: An Icatian border town where Orc attacks were repelled.

entities.name: Battle of Montford
entities.description: A battle in which the Orcs were unsuccessful against Icatia.

entities.name: Ailis Connaut
entities.description: An Icatian Scout knighted for her defense of Montford.

entities.name: Leitbur
entities.description: Figure revered by Icatians and namesake of the Order of Leitbur.

entities.name: Order of Leitbur
entities.description: Followers of Leitbur who sought to eradicate the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Vodalians
entities.description: Merfolk empire attacked by Homarids; they fight underwater in schools.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Raiders that thrived in the cooling climate and overwhelmed Vodalia.

entities.name: Svyelun
entities.description: Goddess of the Pearl Moon worshipped by early Vodalians.

entities.name: General Khurzog
entities.description: A general who commented on tides, Goblins and spies.

entities.name: Pashadar Dirf
entities.description: A Goblin Flotilla Commander whose last words mocked Merfolk magic.

entities.name: Marshall Volnikov
entities.description: A commander who exhorted Vodalian Soldiers.

entities.name: Jherana Rure
entities.description: A Counter-Insurgency Commander killed by Necrites.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: Master Breeder who created the Thrulls and was later ordered executed.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Creatures bred by the Order of the Ebon Hand that rebelled and overwhelmed it.

entities.name: Thrull Rebellion
entities.description: A rebellion in which Thrulls turned on the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Necrites
entities.description: Beings that killed Jherana Rure, ending the counter-insurgency.

entities.name: Cpl. Dobbs
entities.description: A soldier who commented on the Necrite.

entities.name: Corporal Peter Douglas
entities.description: A soldier who gave courtmartial testimony about the War Drums.

entities.name: Brassclaw Orcs
entities.description: Orcs who raided Icatian and Dwarven towns by lightning attacks.

entities.name: Dwarves of Sarpadia
entities.description: Dwarves whose walled city-states fell to Orcs and Goblins first.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Site of a mass grave of Dwarves.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: The continent whose empires fell as the climate cooled.

entities.name: Havenwood
entities.description: An Elven forest of isolated villages acting as a single community.

entities.name: Elves of Havenwood
entities.description: Elves with fortresses grown from the forest and an improvised militia.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungus-bred creatures nearly impossible to kill.

entities.name: Kyliki of Havenwood
entities.description: Elf who wrote of the Homarid-flooded forest and feared the Thallids would overwhelm Fortresses.

entities.name: Kolevi of Havenwood
entities.description: Elder Druid of Havenwood.

entities.name: Thelonites
entities.description: Elven druids and monks who turned to blood fertilizing.

entities.name: Delif
entities.description: Author of Ponderings.

entities.name: Rainbow Vale
entities.description: A goal of Knights' quests in feudal Icatia.

events.summary: Following the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally break their ties with the rest of Icatia.
events.quote: After the fall of Trokair, Farrel and his followers formally broke their ties with the rest of Icatia.

events.summary: Farrel's followers become vigilantes battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.
events.quote: Farrel and his followers became a formidable band of vigilantes, battling Icatians and followers of Tourach.

events.summary: The Icatian army repels early Orc surprise attacks on border towns like Montford.
events.quote: The Icatian army easily repelled early surprise attacks by the Orcs on border towns like Montford.

events.summary: Icatian Phalanxes keep fighting after the wall is breached in half a dozen places.
events.quote: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the Phalanxes fought on

events.summary: Ailis Connaut is granted knighthood for her scouting and defense of Montford.
events.quote: Ailis Connaut acted with honor and bravery in the defense of the town of Montford

events.summary: Icatia falls, the last of the Sarpadian empires.
events.quote: Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall.

events.summary: The cooling climate lets Homarids attack Vodalia until the empire is overwhelmed.
events.quote: Their ceaseless attacks strained Vodalia's defenses to their limit, eventually overwhelming the empire.

events.summary: Pashadar Dirf's last words mock Merfolk magic as he flees Vodalian Mages.
events.quote: Come back, cowards! Everyone knows Merfolk can't wield magic!

events.summary: The Thrulls, bred for sacrifice, turn on the Order of the Ebon Hand with gruesome results.
events.quote: the Thrulls eventually turned on their masters, the Order of the Ebon Hand, with gruesome results

events.summary: The Thrulls breed at a terrifying pace and overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: Endrek Sahr creates the first Thrulls by introducing alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy.
events.quote: To create the first Thrulls, I only introduced alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy

events.summary: Necrites kill Jherana Rure, ending the counter-insurgency.
events.quote: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counter-insurgency.

events.summary: An execution order is issued for Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder.
events.quote: From the execution order for Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder

events.summary: Goblin and Orcish armies crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities with War Drums.
events.quote: The War Drums enabled Goblin and Orcish armies to crush the sparsely defended Dwarven cities.

events.summary: The Dwarves' civilization is the first to fall, its name lost.
events.quote: their civilization was the first to fall, and its name was sadly lost

events.summary: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs temper their bloodlust with cowardice.
events.quote: Unsuccessful in their early battle for Montford, the Orcs quickly tempered their bloodlust with cowardice.

events.summary: Corporal Peter Douglas's line breaks to the War Drums in the dark.
events.quote: Dobbs, on my right, broke first.

events.summary: Elves turn to Thallid farming as the climate cools.
events.quote: As the climate cooled, many Elves turned to Thallid farming for food

events.summary: Thelonites turn to fertilizing with fresh blood as the climate worsens.
events.quote: some Thelonites turned to fertilizing with fresh blood in an attempt to keep Havenwood alive and growing
